name: trip-itinerary
description: Builds a full trip itinerary across an ordered list of cities: activities in each city at three effort levels (low, medium, high), and travel between every consecutive pair of cities at three budget tiers (cheapest, mid-range, luxury), every item carrying its own link. Delivers either as a formatted three-tab Excel workbook or directly in the conversation. city-researcher and transportation-researcher can also be used on their own for a single city or a single route. cities-itinerary fans city-researcher out across a list of cities. trip-options-consolidator is the top-level skill that runs all three and merges the results into one deliverable.
